gapReason: Wikipedia/Commons medical categories did not contain 33,000 images with a display license. Fish CT, identification photos, and unlicensed files were not counted.

sources.name: Open-i
sources.access: Public search API https://openi.nlm.nih.gov/api/search responded on 2026-10-29. No license field in the payload.
sources.licenseSummary: Open-i states it cannot grant permission. Copyright stays with the journal. A license link, when one exists, is on the image page, not in the API.
sources.note: Search and link only. Prior oa-catalog.json (3,707 URLs) uses a blanket phrase, not a per-image license, so those rows are excluded.

sources.name: PubMed Central via Europe PMC
sources.access: Europe PMC REST search returns an article license. Figure files are taken only from https CDN URLs on the open article page.
sources.licenseSummary: Only cc by, cc by-sa, cc by-nd, cc0, and public domain are displayable here. NC is excluded.

sources.name: Radiopaedia
sources.access: No tokenless API. Terms forbid scraping and bulk download.
sources.licenseSummary: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 as modified by Radiopaedia terms. Commercial use is not allowed.

sources.name: MedPix
sources.access: No public API verified. NLM page states the teaching file is temporarily unavailable.
sources.note: Link only while the collection is down. Nothing imported.

sources.name: Eurorad
sources.access: No bulk API used. Terms page reviewed 2026-10-29.
sources.licenseSummary: Cases after 2015-07-06 are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Earlier cases forbid downloading and redistribution. Commercial use is forbidden.
sources.note: Link only. NC license is not displayable in this app.

sources.name: The Cancer Imaging Archive
sources.access: Public NBIA REST API getSeries. DICOM bytes were not downloaded.
sources.licenseSummary: Per-series LicenseName from the API. TCGA-KIRC rows checked were CC BY 3.0. Other collections can differ and were not imported.
sources.note: Indexed as series, not as images. Frame counts are not added to the image total. No web preview was verified. Licenses seen: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License (1736).

sources.name: NIH ChestX-ray
sources.access: Official Box folder. Usage is described as unrestricted with attribution. The image archives were not downloaded.
sources.licenseSummary: NIH FAQ, as quoted by the NIH Cloud Healthcare dataset page: unrestricted use if you link the download site, cite Wang et al. CVPR 2017, and credit the NIH Clinical Center.
sources.note: One collection record. The published 112,120 files were not verified here and are not counted.

sources.name: PhysioNet
sources.access: Credentialed access plus a dataset Data Use Agreement. Raw files may not be redistributed.
sources.licenseSummary: PhysioNet credentialed DUA. Not a public image grant.

sources.name: DICOM Library
sources.access: Public sample-file site. No reuse license verified for those samples.

sources.name: OsiriX DICOM Image Library
sources.access: Sample library page. No grant to copy the samples into this app was verified.
sources.licenseSummary: OsiriX graphical assets are all rights reserved. Sample DICOM rights were not established one by one.

sources.name: 3Dicom Library
sources.access: Viewer sample library. Software license is proprietary. Sample image rights were not verified.
sources.licenseSummary: Rights not established for the sample studies.

sources.name: Stanford AIMI datasets
sources.access: Dataset catalogue. No open per-image API verified. Many sets require an application.
sources.licenseSummary: Dataset-specific. Not established for a bulk import.

sources.name: Washington University gamma
sources.access: Only the HTTP homepage supplied by the reader. No verified HTTPS URL. No image requests were sent.
sources.note: Link only, and the link is insecure HTTP. Images are not requested.

sources.name: SNMMI
sources.access: Official public site only. No public bulk image dataset URL was verified. Member learning material was not used.
sources.licenseSummary: Society content. Not a verified open dataset.

sources.name: Deep Blue dataset 0r967394d
sources.access: The work page did not return a title, license, or file list. It was not downloadable.
sources.licenseSummary: Unknown. Deep Blue licenses are per deposit and were not visible for this id.

sources.name: IAEA Human Health
sources.access: Public site. No open image API or reuse grant verified.

sources.name: PEIR Digital Library
sources.access: License page reviewed. No bulk copy.
sources.licenseSummary: UAB license allows limited educational viewing. It forbids publishing or redistributing the database.

sources.name: LearningRadiology
sources.licenseSummary: All rights reserved. Publishing needs written permission.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.access: MediaWiki imageinfo API. LicenseShortName checked per file.
sources.licenseSummary: Only CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-ND, CC0, and public domain. NC excluded.
sources.note: Each file is a Commons image with LicenseShortName allowing display and an image MIME type from the MediaWiki API. Non-medical categories were excluded.
